note: golden-03.html is this skill's clean control, deliberately built to graze every scripted check without tripping it: a specific, non-placeholder title; a well-formed lang="en"; a viewport meta with no user-scalable or maximum-scale restriction; a main landmark plus a leading skip link; a photo with a real descriptive alt attribute; a two-column table using scoped th cells; a heading sequence that steps down one level at a time; link text that names its destination rather than a generic phrase; a form input matched to its label by id; and a submit button whose border resolves to roughly 10:1 contrast against white, with no aria-label to conflict with its visible text. The ZIP field also carries autocomplete="postal-code" explicitly: fix 1's cue-word matching now puts a bare id="zip" in scope for WCAG-1.3.5 (its cue word maps to postal-code) where the exact-token path alone used to miss it, so staying clean here means carrying a valid token rather than relying on a scope gap that no longer exists. The scripted lane correctly returns zero findings and a passing gate, which is what demonstrates it does not hallucinate defects on an artifact that plants none.
